purpose: Allow remaining new attempts to fit the existing $50 cap while reserving a conservative full in-flight request. No result rerolls.
reserve_calculation: 200000 input * $8/M (maximum 1h cache-write rate) + 32000 output * $20/M = $2.24, rounded up to $2.30.
limitations: New attempts only. Mixed runtime profiles must be disclosed. Context/output/budget limit failures do not establish task difficulty.
